//: SHUDDL 'Terminal Gallery' basemap — red engraving on warm concrete. Works with Mapbox GL JS and MapLibre GL JS (shared style spec). Swap `sources` for your provider: self-hosted Protomaps/OpenFreeMap for the product (REQ-075, no third-party branding), or Mapbox tiles for a promo. Source-layer names below match the OpenMapTiles schema (Protomaps/OpenFreeMap/Mapbox-Streets-v8 all follow it, though a few layer names differ — see notes). This is a STARTING POINT: keep the paint values, retarget the sources/source-layers to your tiles.
name: shuddl-terminal-gallery

v.//: Vector source. Product: your self-hosted Protomaps/OpenFreeMap. Promo: mapbox://mapbox.mapbox-streets-v8 (use MapLibre's addProtocol or Mapbox GL). The paint below assumes OpenMapTiles source-layers.

layout.//: thinned aggressively — the map must stay calm; drop labels below city scale

notes: BANNED, do not add: terrain/hillshade, satellite/raster, POI symbols, building fills, landuse greens, any color outside {#D5D1CC field, #FF4A33 signal, #1A1A1A ink, #00C4B4 progress}. The map carries NO color — saturation is reserved for freight entity marks drawn on top.
Entity marks (chevron/square/hollow/pulse + teal ETA fill) are separate GeoJSON sources added at runtime, NOT part of the basemap — see SKILL.md 'Entities'.
text-font must be a glyph fontstack your `glyphs` endpoint actually serves; 'JetBrains Mono Regular' is illustrative. Self-host the JetBrains Mono glyph PBFs to stay on-brand and offline-capable.

Mapbox Streets v8 layer names: transportation->'road', place labels->'place_label', water->'water'. OpenMapTiles (Protomaps/OpenFreeMap): 'transportation','place','water'. Retarget source-layer accordingly; the paint stays identical.
Exception dim: to dim the world to 35%, drop a full-viewport greige (#D5D1CC) veil at ~0.65 opacity ABOVE the basemap and BELOW the pulsing exception mark — do not recolor the style.
